label: sk-code restates stage-one mode selection in four live places plus one generated artifact: SKILL.md:54 names mode-registry.json the source of truth, SKILL.md:76-134 re-expresses selection as Python route(), hub-router.json:24-39 adds weighted classes, ROUTER.md:252 carries a 40-line CI keyword row, and compiled-route.cjs is the projection SKILL.md:56-60 invokes; mode-registry.json holds 4 modes and 83 aliases (13 quality, 10 review, 5 skilled, 55 ci).

ROUTER.md section 2 and section 9 drifted in both directions: TESTING (ROUTER.md:57) and LANGUAGE_STANDARDS (:60) have no section 9 key, and five section 9 intents (JAVASCRIPT, TYPESCRIPT, PYTHON, SHELL, RUST at :247-251) have no section 2 prose row, so the byte-for-byte claim at :223 fails in both directions.

Three docs each claim a different routing authority: SKILL.md:54 says mode-registry.json is the single source of truth, sk-code-review/SKILL.md:612 says Section 2 SMART ROUTING is authoritative, and ROUTER.md:223 calls section 9 the byte-for-byte source a deterministic router parses; only the third is measurably true because parseRouter reads the section 9 block.

The CI vocabulary is copied five times at three sizes: hub-router.json:76-78 code-ci-aliases (55 keywords), ROUTER.md:252 CI_WORKFLOW (61 keywords), sk-code-ci/SKILL.md:62 (12 keywords), mode-registry.json sk-code-ci.aliases (55), plus the packet RESOURCE_MAP at sk-code-ci/SKILL.md:65; the packet header at sk-code-ci/SKILL.md:56 says the 12-keyword set is deliberate, so the copies are intentionally unequal.

The advisor report inventory numbers are wrong and must be corrected before a plan quotes them: it says about 59 aliases in mode-registry.json where the count is 83, and it cites hub-router.json:77 as a CI vocabulary copy where that line is the code-ci-aliases keyword array; the direction of its conclusion survives but its quantities do not.

Two packets describe routing the tooling does not read: sk-code-quality/SKILL.md:30 carries a 15-term Keyword triggers line and :154-156 calls the deterministic router-replay retired, while sk-code-skilled/SKILL.md:178 documents the same replay as the live leg 1 to 4 guard; the guard is the one that runs.

Stage-two leaf choice has no runtime script: compiled-route.cjs emits packet-level resources (hub-router.json:24-39), and leaf-manifest.json has no router consumer, only tests and the compiler, so which leaf files load is decided by prose and each packet machine block rather than by a resolver.

Readability: routing precedes instructions and jargon precedes definition; sk-code-review/SKILL.md opens SMART ROUTING at line 49 and the first executable step tree at line 67, sk-code-quality/SKILL.md:15 opens with "quality is the author-side quality gate MODE child of the sk-code family. It runs after the acting agent applying workflow-implement.md changes the code and before the surface's verification workflow or done-claim.", and sk-code/SKILL.md:15 opens with "One skill, two axes, one shared surface-detection router, and one advisor identity.".

reason: No router consumer reads it; only tests and the compiler do (f-iter001-007).
